prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble. Seen straight down from above, the scene is folded into six mirrored segments round a centre point, as if seen through a brass kaleidoscope, the mirror seams crisp straight lines, each segment the same real photograph repeated so the frame becomes a gold-and-black star. The scene: a counting room with a big table covered in rubber-banded stacks of cash, gangsters in braces counting and snapping bands, a card game at one end, a rat nibbling a bundle, ashtrays overflowing. Light: one hanging lamp over the centre; the edges in deep shadow. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
